difficulty_reason: The lemma makes the grading of the cohomology along powers of the ideal effective: a single constant $c$ bounds both the generation of each graded piece from $I^c\mathcal{F}$ and the gain in the ideal that the transition maps produce (statement lines 4272-4284). The proof extracts the constant from a finite generating set of the graded module, reads part (1) off directly, and then verifies part (2) through a commutative diagram whose horizontal composition is surjective by part (1). The bookkeeping of the two exponents is the substance, so the claim is H2.
